bio: As experiments go, Amprix is one of the most dangerous undertaken in Amara. He is, according to his creator, an "artificial" Titan – powered by an untested memorium dynamo. He has, so far, performed his role of the Evernight Basin's eternal watchman well, but those who Invoke him complain of voices in their heads, yearning to be free...
